issue.title: [Issue]: Dependency conflict upon adding abcvlib as an external dependency

comment.body:
@GeorgeChernyshov was this part of the current scope or something you were just noting for future work? Can you assign the Scope field as necessary? 

I'm not sure I fully understand the issue, but the solution should ensure we can continue to use the gpu support (not exclude it), so just make sure the solution allows for this. Without GPU the object detection is super slow and makes most use-cases unusable.
